scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ringko-ai/code build && pnpm --filter @ringko-ai/tui build && pnpm --filter @ringko-ai/webui build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,webui -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @ringko-ai/app run serve -- --dev" "pnpm --filter @ringko-ai/webui dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @ringko-ai/config test && pnpm --filter @ringko-ai/auth test && pnpm --filter @ringko-ai/session test && pnpm --filter @ringko-ai/harness test && pnpm --filter @ringko-ai/tools test && pnpm --filter @ringko-ai/sdk test && pnpm --filter @ringko-ai/providers test && pnpm --filter @ringko-ai/repl test && pnpm --filter @ringko-ai/tui test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc -p packages/config/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/auth/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/session/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/harness/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/tools/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/providers/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/repl/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/tui/tsconfig.json
